title: SnapUGC scale-up — watch-retention transfer at 68x data

download.source: SnapUGC (ECCV 2024) train CSV = per-video Snapchat-CDN links + ECR label
download.method: multithreaded downloader (24 workers), ~35 videos/s, ~40 MB/s; official dataset CDN, no block-evasion

extraction.method: parallel video decode (8 threads, cv2/ffmpeg) + serial MPS encode

ablation.note: LOCO ROC-AUC on the 262 lingbow multimodal videos. An ECR watch-retention head is trained on SnapUGC content embeddings, then applied to lingbow as a `retention_head` feature and ablated (mm_best vs mm_best+retention).
